source_review.body:
Independent source review clears the identified G3 privacy finding at Solid recovery commit 4fdcdb550577c379b9e50ad91ad47c02eeffa82f, tree 2e55eeacb73185f2c9a4a8c404782bd65ef66590. Use this corrected candidate, not held bd319b438e6e8ef92235050fb6475f957efe110b.

I compared the corrected head with current Solid main f668c090e00b1a5792406075476620aad49f8890. The fifteen-file diff removes the probe and retains the existing Telegram-link privacy boundary, the PR65 fixture change and unrelated main. The unchanged middleware continues to apply private response and error headers through the shared classifier. The four-file correction from the held revert restores the alias refusal and callback scrubbing and adds existing-link regression coverage.

An independent bounded reproduction evaluated the fetched privacy and actual entry-server render modules with the installed pinned router 2.0.0-next.16. Thirty route spellings agree with the router classification. All twenty-four matching noncanonical aliases across the three existing link routes return an empty private 404, scrub synthetic callback values from the effective SSR request and avoid downstream rendering/preflight. Source blobs are privacy 0f93ca3ba80f7c3f6cb0e63abc362cd6e7572ffe, entry-server a6d543aaf0e061ac7514702fe41def59dc6391c8 and middleware 894f129e43802d4c8e5799a5952468003461b885. This is source/control-flow evidence with downstream dependencies stubbed; I did not rerun the full Solid suite or observe a deployed Worker. The cloud-reported full suites, build and fingerprint remain separately attributed evidence.

This clears the requested independent source review of the prepared recovery candidate. It does not instruct deployment or merging of the revert while the probe is needed. If recovery is invoked, publish it through the normal reviewed revert-PR and guarded-main release path, obtain the applicable exact-head checks and bind it to the actual compatible serving predecessor. A draft CI vehicle may be prepared now under existing authority. Preserve the active probe and its deadline.
